job.title: Software Engineer - Applied AI, Defense Applications
job.pay_full: $145,000 – $200,000 a year (estimated); total compensation may also include restricted stock units, a sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives

details.about: Palantir builds software for data-driven decisions and operations. Its Defense Applied AI product team builds products that help military users apply AI to mission-critical work, and this engineer helps own the end-to-end agent experience, working in a small team of software engineers.
duties: Design and build AI agents that help defense and intelligence users investigate questions, analyze operational data and develop plans
Improve the agent experience through data-driven evals of memory, tool and skill design and context management
Build intuitive interfaces for directing agents, following progress and inspecting evidence
Own features from early experimentation through production deployment
Optimize applications for speed and scalability with high-scale, complex data
needs: Coding experience in languages such as Java, C++, Python or JavaScript
Strong software engineering skills and experience delivering production applications
Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript
Engineering background in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics or a similar field
Active US security clearance, or eligibility and willingness to obtain one
nice: Experience building applications with LLMs, including tool design, context management, agent workflows or evaluation
details.benefits: Estimated salary $145,000 – $200,000 a year; total compensation may also include restricted stock units, a sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance, life, AD&D and disability insurance, commuter benefits, relocation assistance, non-accrual paid time off, 2 weeks of paid time off at the end of each year (subject to team and business needs), 10 paid holidays, paid leave for new parents, subsidized back-up care, fertility and family building benefits and a 401(k) plan.
notes: Requires an active US security clearance, or eligibility and willingness to obtain one
